name: The Chaotic Good Spread
about: DRAFT text for Ryan to rewrite. Positions are listed in dealing order: the five points follow the single stroke that draws the Guild star (top, lower right, upper left, upper right, lower left), then the heart in the centre. Each point matches a suit's element: Lutes fire, Quills air, Mirrors water, Galleons earth, and the top point spirit. x and y are percentages of the spread's square table.
